Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang discusses AI and India's startup ecosystem

Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang expressed excitement about Indian startups contributing to the local Artificial Intelligence economy. Speaking to Business Today, Huang stated that the world is at the beginning of an industrial revolution driven by AI. He highlighted the potential for India's burgeoning tech sector to play a significant role in this transformation.
